title: 第372章 烬冠领主第371章 不只是一个人
slug: 迷雾求生从流民开始的领主之路
content_zh:
第372章烬冠领主
那高高在上的深渊巨瞳，永远也不会理解。
祂习惯了看猎物在孤独与绝望中异化成畸形的怪物。
在祂那冰冷、混沌且漫长的认知里，地上的生灵不过是一群为了一口血肉就能互相撕咬的单一个体。
这些下位者不过是上位者的柴薪、养料，甚至是随时可以剥夺意志的玩物。
但它不明白，此刻顶在它眼球下方的那个青年，早已经不是“一个人”了。
那道金红色的薪火光柱里，燃烧的不仅仅是亚修的骨血，更是新烬镇数千人对活下去的极致渴望，是对秩序的绝对信仰！
“嗡——！”
巨瞳不甘地收缩瞳孔。
周遭的虚空如破碎的镜面般剥落。
它强行榨取深渊深处的能量，化作第二道、第三道更粗壮的紫黑雷霆，妄图以绝对的体量将那金红光柱生生砸断。
但，毫无作用。
那股汇聚了千万人心的金红色火焰，犹如一根烧红的钢钉，死死楔在大地之上。
任凭深渊的气息如何冲刷，也无法让其退后哪怕一毫米。
“嘶——”
一声却足以令空间扭曲的低鸣从天外传来。
巨瞳停止了攻击。
它那冰冷、死寂的目光，穿透了重重火海，最后一次落在了亚修的身上。
没有狂怒，也没有歇斯底里。
它就像是个随手抛下几枚碎铜板打发时间的赌场豪客。

本以为能随意碾死一只蚂蚁，却意外输给了一个连上桌资格都没有的乞丐。
对它这等不可名状的存在而言，这点损失连九牛一毛都算不上，但被凡物拒绝的冒犯，依然让它感到了一丝恼怒。
没有再继续浪费时间。
在彻底闭合前，那巨大的眼珠极其缓慢地转动了一下。
它死死盯着亚修。
像是在将这张脸、将这股气息，深深地刻进深渊的记忆里。
随后。
虚空裂缝如同拉链般悄无声息地合拢。
紫黑色的巨瞳消失了。
漫天压顶的深渊威压，在这一瞬间荡然无存。
“轰——”
失去了阻挡，那道金红色的薪火光柱再无阻碍，以一种摧枯拉朽的狂暴姿态，直插天际。
一阵让人耳膜失聪的锐鸣后。
紧接着，一圈犹如实质的透明气浪，以光柱与巨瞳的撞击点为圆心，向着四面八方轰然荡开。
content_en:
Chapter 372 Lord Ember Crown
That giant eye of the abyss, which is so high above, will never understand.
He was used to watching his prey transform into deformed monsters in loneliness and despair.
In his cold, chaotic and long-lasting knowledge, the creatures on the earth are just a group of single individuals who can bite each other for a bite of flesh and blood.
These inferiors are nothing more than firewood, nourishment, and even playthings that can deprive the superior of their will at any time.
But it doesn't understand that the young man standing under its eyeballs is no longer "a person".
What was burning in that golden-red pillar of fire was not only the bones and blood of Ash, but also the extreme desire of thousands of people in New Ember Town to live, and their absolute belief in order!
“Buzz——!”
The giant pupils narrowed unwillingly.
The void around him peeled off like a broken mirror.
It forcibly squeezed the energy from the depths of the abyss, turning it into the second and third thicker purple-black thunderbolts, trying to smash the golden-red light pillar with its absolute size.
But, it has no effect.
The golden-red flame that gathered millions of people's hearts was like a red-hot steel nail wedged firmly in the earth.
No matter how the aura of the abyss washes away, it cannot move back even a millimeter.
"Hiss——"
A low cry that was enough to distort the space came from outside.
The giant pupil stopped attacking.
Its cold, dead gaze penetrated the sea of ​​fire and landed on Ash for the last time.
There was no fury, no hysteria.
It's like a casino high roller throwing away a few scraps of coins to pass the time.
I thought I could crush an ant at will, but unexpectedly lost to a beggar who was not even qualified to serve at the table.
For an indescribable existence like it, this loss is not even a drop in the bucket, but the offense of being rejected by a mortal thing still makes it feel a little angry.
No more wasting time.
Before closing completely, the huge eyes moved extremely slowly.
It stared at Ash.
It was as if this face and this breath were being engraved deeply into the abyss of memory.
Subsequently.
The cracks in the void closed silently like a zipper.
The huge purple-black pupils disappeared.
The pressure of the abyss that filled the sky disappeared in this moment.
"Boom——"
Without any obstruction, the golden-red pillar of fire light was no longer hindered, and shot straight into the sky with a destructive and violent attitude.
After a sharp roar that deafens the eardrums.
Immediately afterwards, a circle of transparent air waves that seemed to be substantial, with the impact point of the light beam and the giant pupil as the center of the circle, roared in all directions.
